svg.text: PROOF GUIDES (not printed on the roll)

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: red = 23 mm die-cut edge · grey dash = printable area 17.1 × 20.0 mm · blue dash = band boundaries (fold on either)

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: PRINTED ON THE ROLL: three identical copies of the text, plus band ticks at the label edges.

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: TRIPLE PRINT: fold on either band tick. The fold eats one copy; the other two stay whole, one per face.

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom copy prints upright; the upper two print 180 deg, so whichever surfaces on the back face reads the right way up. The fold no longer has to be accurate.

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: DEVICE SWATCH — the two chips under each label are end A | end B, each named on its own colour.

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: DK-1221 prints BLACK ONLY: the labels themselves carry no colour. On the rack, match the cable tie to the chip colour.
